description: Writes rows into one commitment by date: a statement's months for a commitment that already exists (paid, basis "statement"), or more planned months than the app keeps. The app never grows a plan on its own, so this is how one grows. The commitment is named by id or the exact name as the memory holds it — a miss answers with the real names. A row already there for a day is updated in place, never doubled. An amount left out is the commitment's price. The answer carries balance_note when the account's balance is now older than the newest row written. Writes are schema-validated and provenance-stamped, and land in the app's Changes screen where the owner keeps or undoes the whole batch. Card numbers, CVVs and credentials are refused by the validator, which names the row. `source` ("documents/hdfc-2026.pdf", "gmail:18c2…") records where a row came from in the diff.

amount.description: A number, zero or more, up to 1,000,000,000,000,000.

note.description: A word about this one charge. Null clears.

paid_on.description: The day the money moved, when it was not the due date. Null clears.
